description: Date-held standing item: the site contract bump must not start before 2026-11-18. On or after that date, re-read the live contract state in BenchBox-dev/benchbox and benchbox-site before proposing any change. Guardrails (all items): primary clone read-only; work only in a linked worktree from origin/develop (make worktree-create + make agent-write-preflight); never git add -A or git stash; identity Joe Harris, no agent attribution; never bypass hooks by any route; no code comments/docstrings (make comment-policy-check clean); encoding="utf-8" on file/subprocess text I/O; uv run -- for Python; no CHANGELOG entries; never weaken or delete tests or gates; TEST LOCK: never set BENCHBOX_SKIP_TEST_LOCK or BENCHBOX_TEST_LOCK_DIR, never run make test-unlock, xdist only under the shared lock; for make pr-open put ~/.cache/omp-18.12.1/bin first on PATH; make pr-preflight once, make pr-open, make pr-arm; never post oracle comments or rerun the oracle; commit/PR text for a reader who never saw this session (no item ids or plan labels).
